title: Conversation previews — look like the real chat

steps.path: Type /resume, then click a conversation in the list
steps.headline: The preview on the right now shows the conversation the way the chat will after you resume it.
steps.changed: The preview is drawn by the chat's own bubbles, tool groups and reasoning sections, built by the same logic a resumed chat uses. It sits on the chat's background, with your wallpaper behind the bubbles.
steps.notice: Tool work shows as the usual tool group ("Read a file and searched the code") instead of "3 tools — not shown". Background notes no longer appear as your own bubbles. Wallpaper themes show the wallpaper under frosted bubbles.
steps.risk: Older messages now load in pages of 30 turns as you scroll up, like the chat, so a very tool-heavy conversation shows less on first open than before.

steps.path: Click Preview on a conversation the assistant found for you
steps.headline: The side-panel preview matches the chat next to it.
steps.changed: Same new preview as the Resume browser: the chat's own bubbles and tool groups, on the chat's background.
steps.notice: The panel and the chat beside it now read as the same kind of conversation. On wallpaper themes the wallpaper shows through here too.

steps.path: Projects, Conversations tab, click a conversation
steps.headline: The Projects page preview now shows the conversation instead of "No messages to preview", in the same chat style.
steps.changed: It uses the same preview as the other two. The 20-message limit and the "Open full transcript" button are gone; scrolling up loads older messages. The strip under the title now shows only the date.
steps.measured: Before: 0 messages shown in the test app. After: the newest 10 turns, with tool groups.
steps.notice: A long conversation no longer needs a button to see more, and never loads all at once. This preview now also works from a phone browser, which it never did before.
steps.risk: The "Open full transcript" button you may be used to is gone, and the "last N messages · read-only preview" line is now just the date (the pane itself still says read-only).

steps.headline: Conversation cards on the Projects page now look like the Resume browser's cards.
steps.changed: Same card surface and border, bold title, tag chips, and the bottom line with model, size and date. The chat-bubble icon on the left is gone. The first line of the conversation stays under the title, since it tells two similar titles apart.
steps.notice: Priority and tags now show on these cards, and hovering a card brightens its border like in the Resume browser.
steps.risk: Tags, notes and the model only appear when this page's list has them. It is built from a thinner source than the Resume browser, so some cards show fewer details there than in /resume.
